summary: NICE Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 earnings press release. The filing reports total revenue of $782.3 million, up 7.6% year-over-year, with cloud revenue up 12.6% to $609.0 million. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.70, and the company raised its full-year 2026 EPS guidance. CEO Scott Russell commented on strong AI bookings and CXone platform momentum. The filing is routine periodic reporting of financial results with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or tender offers. It incorporates GAAP financials into existing registration statements.
